messages:
maria-support: Hey team — customer clicked redeem and got the green check but their org balance is still 0. Org: org_98765, email: kate@example.com. Code: TRIAL-APR-2026. Webhook returned 200 at ~2026-03-15T14:33Z. Can someone pick this up?

billing-ops: On it. Can you paste the claim_id from the confirmation page and the exact timestamp? I'll grep the ledger/ingest logs.

maria-support: claim_id claim_4432, submitted 2026-03-15T14:33:12Z. Screenshot: https://redwood.s3/claims/claim_4432.png

rohan-eng: I pulled the ingest trace — webhook 8a7f2c... was accepted by promo-ingest but the downstream job errored with 422: missing billing_profile_id. That aligns with the billing migration on 2026-03-14 where some tenant->billing_profile mappings weren't populated.

billing-ops: Confirmed. Promos arriving in that migration window can miss linkage. I'll queue a reprocess for claim_4432 to attach it to org_98765. Reprocess job created: job_554321.

maria-support: Customer is trying to run smoke tests now and is blocked. Any short-term workaround?

rohan-eng: Quick manual workaround: admin UI -> Billing -> Credits -> Add. I can add a temporary grant so they can continue testing while we reprocess the ingest.

rohan-eng: Done — manual grant manual_9071 (5000 credits) added with comment 'temp-grant pending-ledger-fix job_554321' :white_check_mark:

billing-ops: Reprocess complete — ledger entry written and linked to org_98765. We'll keep the manual grant for ~24h then reverse it once reconciliation confirms the ledger entry is stable. Reversal will be automated (reverse_txn_8812).

maria-support: Perfect, I'll confirm with the customer and close the loop. Appreciated @rohan-eng @billing-ops :pray:

billing-ops: Root cause: missing billing_profile during migration. Filed follow-up infra#3456 to add a post-migration reconcile that scans unlinked promo events.
